verdict.rationale: A customer reports that Pilot's integrations with their banks and credit cards handle transactions automatically. First-party docs claim real-time account data in the portal and integrations with hundreds of tools, but never explicitly describe bank or card account connections or an automatic daily import. missing for 10: first-party documentation of bank and credit-card account linking, an explicit automatic daily import cadence, details of supported institutions and the founder-side connection flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect bank and credit-card accounts so transactions import automatically every day

citations.quote: their integrations with my banks, expensify, credit cards, etc handle all of the transaction classification
